items.headline: NVIDIA released Nemotron-Labs-Sigma, 14 open diffusion language model checkpoints at 3B and 8B
items.excerpt: NVIDIA released Nemotron-Labs-Sigma on 20 November, a family of 14 open-weights checkpoints at 3B and 8B parameters that form a continuous diffusion language model.

items.headline: Simplex AI open-sourced Linger, running a 125B model on a 12GB GPU
items.excerpt: Simplex AI, founded by former DeepSeek-VL lead Zhang Bo, open-sourced Linger on 19 November, a local agent it says runs a 125B model on a 12GB GPU at 45.5 tokens per second.

items.headline: Google released Gemini 4 Neon, scoring 61 on the Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index
items.excerpt: Google DeepMind released Gemini 4 Neon on 18 November, a mid-tier Gemini 4 model that scores 61 on the Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index at $3 per million input tokens.

items.headline: SenseTime released open-weight SenseNova-Loop-9B, a looped model with 512K context
items.excerpt: SenseTime released the final SenseNova-Loop-9B on 17 November as open weights and code, a model of about 9 billion parameters that it says scores 69.90 on GAIA.

items.headline: Microsoft says MAI Code 2 matches 98% of GPT-6.1 Sol at 40% of cost
items.excerpt: Microsoft released MAI Code 2 at its Ignite conference on 17 November and says the model gives 98% of GPT-6.1 Sol's coding performance at 40% of the price.

items.headline: NVIDIA's Vera Rubin posts up to 2x GB300's per-GPU training speed on MLPerf
items.excerpt: NVIDIA reported on 16 November that its Vera Rubin NVL72 system delivered up to 2x the per-GPU training performance of GB300 NVL72 in MLPerf Training v6.1.
